test_docstring_options: test pybind11 docstring options by asserting function and overload docstrings are set or suppressed correctly
test_disable_function_signatures: test that disable_function_signatures removes function signature lines from pybind11 docstrings
test_custom_docstring: test that a custom docstring is applied to a pybind11 bound function
test_overloaded_docstrings: test that docstrings are concatenated or selected across pybind11 overloaded function definitions
test_disable_user_defined_docstrings: test that disable_user_defined_docstrings suppresses custom docstrings on functions and class properties
